name: Vanadium oxide / titania SCR catalyst material
description: Vanadium oxide / titania SCR catalyst material named on a page read in the GEG gap-fill for Diesel oxidation catalyst and SCR emission control system.

specifications.basis: Chalmers licentiate thesis 2023:09, §2.2 'Vanadium-based SCR catalysts' and Fig. 2.1. Printed 2023; read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: VO x / TiO 2 (anatase TiO 2 support, monomeric/polymeric/crystalline V2O5 specie)

Chalmers thesis §2.2 and §4: 'Present industrial VO x-SCR catalysts contain around 1-3 wt% vanadium'; 'around 2 wt% vanadium as a good compromise'. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: Around 1–3 wt% vanadium (≈2 wt% as compromise between activity and high-temperat)
Chalmers thesis §2.3 and Fig. 2.3. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: Approximately 300–400 °C (exhaust range 150–650 °C))
Chalmers thesis §2.3. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: Vanadium volatility/release starting from 500 °C; TiO 2 anatase-to-rutile transf)

Chalmers thesis §2.3: 'The Occupational Safety and Health Administration have declared V 2O5 as a contaminant with strict disposal limits (0.5 mg/m 3 for dust)'. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: 0.5 mg/m 3 for dust (OSHA contaminant limit as cited))
Chalmers thesis §2.4 'Implementation of promoters'. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: Tungsten and molybdenum (thermal/structural stability, sulfur resistance); Si, M)
Chalmers thesis §3.1 and Table 3.1. Read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25. (value: Incipient wetness impregnation on DT-51D TiO 2 (Tronox, 99 wt% anatase); calcine)
